verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Floot generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product. The closest items are adjacent: MCP tools such as query_database and get_logs let an external assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) read data, and the built-in visitor tracking shows page views and trends without any AI analysis. Neither is an in-product AI insights capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
